channel.title: Game on Grandparents
channel.desc: Skilled kid gamers coach their novice grandparents to compete in an epic esports battle in the hope of becoming the GOAT of Game on Grandparents! Girls and boys who dream of playing at an eSports tournament are about to get the chance, but there is a twist - they won't be playing themselves but instead have to train their gran or grandad! While their grandparents are busy practising, the children have to take on their roles about the house, from washing up or walking the dog, to entertaining grandma?s friends for the afternoon ? what could possibly go wrong?
